These compounds all share the common target of SCCH-26, indicating a possible pathway where Astersaponin F may exert its effects through this kinase. The scores from the different paths suggest a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, with varying degrees of support from the evidence. The integration of these findings implies that Astersaponin F may act through a kinase pathway that influences SCCH-26, though further experimental validation is needed to confirm the exact mechanism and the role of the intermediate targets.
